entries.name: company-binding-comparison-dropped
entries.claim: A write naming an existing company-owned record and carrying the entered company is refused when the persisted record belongs to another company: through a form, archive and restore, in flight, on a replay of an unbound receipt, and for a principal granted only the entered company.

kills.name: an edit posted through a page entered in A does not change B's record
kills.expected: B's record must not be written through A's page

kills.name: archive and restore are bound to the entered company
kills.expected: archiving B's record through A's page must be refused

kills.name: the comparison reads the persisted row under its lock
kills.expected: the in-flight edit of a record moved to B must be refused

kills.name: a request key recorded without the company still replays, and only in its own company
a principal granted only company A writes A's records and no others

entries.name: company-binding-compares-the-operand
entries.claim: The company the write is compared with is read from the persisted row, not taken from the request: comparing the operand with itself admits every company.

kills.name: an edit posted through a page entered in A does not change B's record
kills.expected: B's record must not be written through A's page

kills.name: archive and restore are bound to the entered company
kills.expected: archiving B's record through A's page must be refused

kills.name: the comparison reads the persisted row under its lock
kills.expected: the in-flight edit of a record moved to B must be refused

kills.name: a request key recorded without the company still replays, and only in its own company
a principal granted only company A writes A's records and no others

entries.name: company-binding-read-without-lock
entries.claim: The persisted company is read under the record's FOR NO KEY UPDATE lock, so a write the comparison admits is the write that lands: without it, a record moved to another company while the write waited is written anyway.

kills.name: the comparison reads the persisted row under its lock
kills.expected: the in-flight edit of a record moved to B must be refused

entries.name: company-binding-unbound-replay-unchecked
entries.claim: A bound retry of a request key recorded without the company replays only when the record it wrote is in the named company.

kills.name: a request key recorded without the company still replays, and only in its own company

entries.name: company-binding-unbound-replay-removed
entries.claim: A request key recorded before writes carried the company (its digest is the unbound input's) still replays for a bound retry instead of conflicting.

kills.name: a request key recorded without the company still replays, and only in its own company
kills.expected: already bound to different canonical input

entries.name: company-binding-on-tenant-record-admitted
entries.claim: A company named on a write of a tenant-level record is refused by name before any write, so a company grant is never scoped onto a record no company owns.

entries.name: company-binding-web-update-unbound
entries.claim: The web runtime's update of a company-owned record carries the company the page was entered in, as archive and restore do.

kills.name: COMPANY-BOUND-WRITES: a scoped update, archive and restore carry the URL company, and a tenant-level one carries none
kills.expected: every write naming an existing record carries the page's company
